messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: Make pop size and growth like 10x less. Make sure the economics stay the same a country with 10m people before hand should make just as much with the 1m people they have after the change and the economy should grow just as much every tick (although personally I think that should be less too). Right now you only start having a proper economy at billions of people, a large country is like tens of billions, hundreds of millions is nothing, this should change so a large population is more in line with what a large population is irl

messages.author: ivegottogodosomething
messages.text: This would put most people in that 30-60m range that most countries have excluding a couple 100m countries one 200m and one 1B country

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: In addition I'd suggest increasing food requirements

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: Food is basically worthless and this is the only game I've seen a resource go for 1 ppu
